name: pure-css-image-hover-effects
description: A copy-paste library of pure CSS image hover effects. The runtime site is plain HTML/CSS with no build step; these npm scripts are contributor tooling for the metadata-driven catalogue pipeline.

scripts.build: node scripts/build-site.mjs && node scripts/build-catalog.mjs --apply && node scripts/build-readme.mjs --apply && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.check: node scripts/validate-catalog.js && node scripts/build-site.mjs --check && node scripts/build-catalog.mjs --check && node scripts/build-readme.mjs --check && node scripts/build.mjs --check
